<style>
  :root {

  .proj-hero-tag {

  }
  .proj-hero-tag::before { content: ''; width: 28px; height: 1px; background: #00b4d8; }
  .proj-hero h1 {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;

    font-weight: 700;
    color: #fff;
    letter-spacing: -1px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .proj-hero h1 span {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0070f3, #00b4d8);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
  }
  .proj-hero p {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);

    line-height: 1.7;
    font-weight: 300;

    z-index: 1;
  }

  .proj-section {
    padding: 70px 6vw;

    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .projects-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
    gap: 22px;
  }

  .proj-card {
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    display: block;
  }
  .proj-card:hover {
    border-color: rgba(0,112,243,0.3);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0,112,243,0.1);
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    text-decoration: none !important;
  }

  .proj-top { height: 5px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), var(--cyan)); }
  .proj-card:nth-child(2) .proj-top { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan), var(--blue)); }
  .proj-card:nth-child(3) .proj-top { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), #005bc4); }
  .proj-card:nth-child(4) .proj-top { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan), var(--blue)); }
  .proj-card:nth-child(5) .proj-top { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), var(--cyan)); }

  .proj-body { padding: 26px; }
  .proj-icon { font-size: 28px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .proj-title {
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  }
  .proj-desc {
    font-size: 13.5px;
    color: var(--muted);
    line-height: 1.7;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  .proj-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .ptag {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    padding: 3px 9px;
    background: rgba(0,112,243,0.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,112,243,0.12);
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: var(--blue);
  }
  .proj-link {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--blue);
    font-weight: 500;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
  }

  .coming-soon {
    opacity: 0.5;
    cursor: default;
  }
  .coming-soon:hover {
    transform: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border-color: var(--border) !important;
  }
</style>
